title: ABOUT DELLA RICE
body_html:
ABOUT DELLA RICE

Crafting Better Rice Since 1986

Della Rice was founded in 1986 by Lehman Fowler of Brinkley, Arkansas, under the name Della Gourmet Rice. After his retirement in 1994, the Ajmera Family acquired the business, expanded it nationwide, and introduced the organic product line now sold as Della Organic Rice.
Since 2020, Della has been proudly owned and operated by Stephen and Micah Hilsdon, both born and raised in Brinkley. With deep roots in the rice industry, they took ownership of Specialty Rice to preserve local jobs and uphold Della’s long-standing values. Stephen began as General Manager in 2006, later joined by Micah as Quality Manager.

We Are Family Owned

Specialty Rice Inc. is still a family-owned business, run by Stephen and Micah Hilsdon of Brinkley, Arkansas. They both are from this town and have been in the rice industry and the community their whole lives.

They’re so proud to call Brinkley home. When the opportunity arose to purchase the company, their decision was driven by one clear purpose: protect local jobs and keep the business rooted in Brinkley. The employees of Specialty Rice are more than coworkers, they are friends, neighbors, and extended family.

Preserving those jobs meant preserving livelihoods, supporting families, and sustaining the local economy. Carrying forward the legacy of Della Rice was not just a business decision, but a personal commitment to the people who helped build it.

The Farming Community

As lifelong members of the farming community, Stephen and Micah deeply value the growers who partner with them. They are committed to helping farmers receive fair, competitive pricing for the rice they produce, recognizing that strong farms build strong communities. Their hands-on understanding of agriculture drives a shared respect for the hard work and dedication that goes into every harvest. Looking ahead, Specialty Rice Inc. is also committed to environmental responsibility. The company is investing increasingly in regenerative rice practices, which are designed to improve soil health, conserve water, and minimize environmental impact. By doing so, the company ensures that future generations can continue farming the land productively and sustainably. Specialty Rice Inc. is on a mission to grow and thrive, all while preserving jobs, supporting farmers, and being environmentally friendly. They’re living up to their legacy of community, stewardship, and family values.

100% All-Natural, Premium American-Grown Rice

Quality and purity from our family to yours.

At Della Rice, we believe that the best meals start with the best ingredients. As a locally owned and family-operated small business, we pride ourselves on delivering rice that is as close to nature as possible.
Since 1986, we have built our legacy on knowing exactly where our product comes from and what goes into every single bag. The majority of our all-natural rice is sourced directly from dedicated Arkansas farmers, who proudly produce over 40% of the nation’s rice every year.

The Della Natural Promise:

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: February 4, 2025

Specialty Rice, Inc., doing business as Della Rice (“we,” “us,” or “our”), is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit https://dellarice.com (“the Site”) or make a purchase.

1. Information We Collect

Personal Information: When you place an order, create an account, or contact us, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, billing and shipping addresses, and payment information.

Automatically Collected Information: We may collect your IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URLs, pages viewed, and the dates and times of your visits through cookies and similar tracking technologies.

Cookies and Tracking: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to: process and fulfill your orders; communicate with you about your orders, products, and promotions; improve our Site and customer experience; detect and prevent fraud; comply with legal obligations; and send marketing communications (with your consent, where required).

3. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with: service providers who assist with payment processing, shipping, and website operations; law enforcement or government agencies when required by law; and business partners in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets (in which case you would be notified).

4. Data Security

We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

6. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to: access, correct, or delete your personal information; opt out of marketing communications by clicking the “unsubscribe” link in our emails; request information about how your data is processed; and lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

7. Third-Party Links

Our Site may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

8. Children’s Privacy

Our Site is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn that we have collected information from a child under 13, we will promptly delete it.

9. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

10. Contact Us

If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

1000 W. First St., Brinkley, AR 72021

title: Refund and Returns Policy
body_html:
Refund and Returns Policy

Effective Date: February 4, 2025

At Della Rice, we take pride in delivering high-quality rice products. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, we are here to help.

1. Damaged or Defective Products

If your order arrives damaged, defective, or with an incorrect item, please contact us within 7 days of delivery. We will arrange a replacement or issue a full refund at no additional cost to you. Please include your order number, a description of the issue, and photos of the damaged or defective product.

2. Order Cancellations

Orders may be cancelled before they have been shipped. Once an order has been dispatched, it cannot be cancelled. Please contact us as soon as possible if you need to cancel an order.

3. Returns

Due to the perishable nature of food products, we generally do not accept returns of opened or used products. Unopened products in their original packaging may be eligible for return within 14 days of delivery, subject to approval. Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the return is due to our error.

4. Refund Process

Once we receive and inspect a returned item (or verify a damage/defect claim), we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. Approved refunds will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days. Please note that your bank or credit card company may take additional time to post the refund to your account.

5. Non-Refundable Items

The following are not eligible for refund: products that have been opened or partially consumed (unless defective); orders returned without prior authorization; and items not purchased directly from our website.

6. Shipping Costs

Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return or refund is due to an error on our part (e.g., wrong item shipped, damaged product). If you received free shipping on your order, the actual shipping cost may be deducted from your refund for non-defective returns.

7. Exchanges

We do not currently offer direct exchanges. If you would like a different product, please return the original item (if eligible) and place a new order.

8. Contact Us

For all refund and return inquiries, please contact us:

Della Rice (Specialty Rice, Inc.)

1000 W. First St., Brinkley, AR 72021

Phone: (870) 734-1233

Email: info@dellarice.com

Please include your order number and a detailed description of your concern so we can assist you as quickly as possible.

title: Explore our rice variety
body_html:
Explore our rice variety

Natural Facts Organic Facts Regenerative FACTS

Crafting Better Rice Since 1986

Della Rice was founded in 1986 by Lehman Fowler of Brinkley, Arkansas, under the name Della Gourmet Rice. After his retirement in 1994, the Ajmera Family acquired the business, expanded it nationwide, and introduced the organic product line now sold as Della Organic Rice.

Since 2020, Della has been proudly owned and operated by Stephen and Micah Hilsdon, both born and raised in Brinkley. With deep roots in the rice industry, they took ownership of Specialty Rice to preserve local jobs and uphold Della’s long-standing values. Stephen began as General Manager in 2006, later joined by Micah as Quality Manager.

Our Promise to You
